children.name: Legionella pneumophila
children.description: Legionella pneumophila, the primary causative agent for Legionnaires’ disease, is an aerobic, pleomorphic, flagellated, non-spore-forming, Gram-negative bacterium.

children.name: Legionella busanensis
children.description: Legionella busanensis is a Gram-negative, catalase- and oxidase-positive bacterium from the genus Legionella with a single subpolar flagellum, which was isolated from cooling tower water in Busan in Korea.
